# FS Ai Agency website integrations

> @franchiseai/website-integrations 0.2.0: Funnel qualification and Offerings consumer enquiries for React/Astro. Repository-only Portal enrollment prototype; not in npm 0.1.0. The website owns all presentation.

First identify consumer Offerings, Funnel qualification or Portal enrollment from supplied configuration; ask if unclear. For consumer enquiries read offerings.md and use the 0.2.0 release candidate until its live deployment is verified. For Funnel, read getting started and the contract; use the demo until a published live configuration is supplied. For Portal, read portal.md and use only the repository prototype, preserving password signup with email confirmation and Google/LinkedIn alternatives. No live Portal adapter exists. Preserve server decisions and optional consent. Never expose application credentials.
